events.body:
## Context

The pipe-to-shell rule in `src/blt_mayo/rules/shell_execution.py` (about L27-30, and the encoded-execution rule at L65-67) misses common variants: `curl ... | /bin/bash`, `curl ... | sudo -E bash`, `bash <(curl -s ...)` and `echo ... | base64 -d | /bin/sh` all produce no findings.

## What to do

1. Allow an optional `(/usr)?/bin/` prefix and sudo flags.
2. Add a process-substitution pattern for `bash <(curl|wget ...)`.
3. Add cases to `tests/test_shell_execution_rules.py` and `tests/fixtures/shell/dangerous.sh`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The four lines above are flagged
- [ ] `safe.sh` still has 0 findings
- [ ] Coverage stays >= 80%

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-mayo
```
